title: Mass scales by λ^k under the dilation push-forward
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, λ > 0 and X, Y ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ k). Assume Y(ω) = X(η) for all test forms ω, η ∈ TestFormOn univ k whose underlying forms satisfy η = δ_λ^#ω := affinePullbackForm (λ·id) 0 ω (this is δ_{λ#}X(ω) = X(δ_λ^#ω), i.e. Y = δ_{λ#}X is the push-forward of X under δ_λ(x) = λx). Then M(Y) = λ^k·M(X) in [0, ∞], precisely Y.mass = ENNReal.ofReal(λ^k) * X.mass. Here M(T) = T.mass = T.massOn univ is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal(T(ω)) over the test forms ω ∈ TestFormOn univ k with tsupport ω ⊆ univ and Euclidean coefficient norm covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ 1 for all x (SimonGMT massAdmissibleOn univ k univ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∀ X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, (∀ ω η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) = affinePullbackForm (lam • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P)) 0 (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) → Y ω = X η) → Y.mass = ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ k) * X.mass
